data.why: bids_events.tsv/.json is a clean events file + BIDS JSON sidecar pair taken verbatim from the repo's own unit-test fixtures (tests/data/bids_events.tsv, tests/data/bids_events.json) for the Events validate/assemble/search/sidecar-template tools; bids_events_bad.json is the same sidecar with one tag deliberately corrupted ('BlechDrawing') to exercise the validator's error path; SpreadsheetTest.tsv (tests/data/SpreadsheetTest.tsv) is a 4-column HED tagging spreadsheet for the Spreadsheets tool; def_test.json (tests/data/def_test.json) is a tiny HED Definition snippet usable with the Strings/definitions-input tool. The bundled BIDS EEG demo dataset (service_tests/data/eeg_ds003645s_hed_demo) is also copied in as a second, more complex events+sidecar pair with onset/duration/HED Def fields.

goals: Validate a BIDS events.tsv file together with its JSON sidecar to find HED tag errors before submitting to an EEG dataset
Validate a BIDS JSON sidecar that has a known typo in a HED tag and confirm the validator reports it
Assemble the full HED annotation strings for each row of an events file, for manual review or secondary analysis
Generate a JSON sidecar template directly from an events file's column names, as a starting point for new annotation
Validate and tag-convert a HED annotation spreadsheet (xlsx/tsv) used to assign HED tags to event codes
Validate a free-standing HED string (e.g. a Definition) for syntactic correctness against a chosen HED schema version

review.summary: The tree captures what the README says the tool is for (validating, assembling, searching and authoring annotations for event data), and the ten screens I opened all back up their nodes. Before filing, it needs the missing README actions added (merge, remodel, convert to short), the test-data repeat tasks folded into t1, and features f1, f3 and f6 trimmed of unseen or over-broad claims.
